faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any driver or registered owner to violate any of the provisions
               of this division, and any such violation shall be punishable as set forth herein.
(b)
The city council shall specify by suitable schedule the civil penalty for any violation
               of this division that involves signage that limits, regulates, restricts, or prohibits
               the parking, standing, or stopping of any vehicle. The city council shall also specify
               by suitable schedule a late fee for unpaid citations as may be appropriate.
(c)
Every driver or registered owner deemed responsible for a violation of this division
               that involves signage that limits, regulates, restricts, or prohibits the parking,
               standing, or stopping of any vehicle shall be punishable by a civil penalty not to
               exceed the limits established for a fine in
section 1-5
of this Code.
(d)
Every day any violation of this division that involves signage that limits, regulates,
               restricts, or prohibits the parking, standing, or stopping of any vehicle is committed
               or permitted to continue shall constitute a separate offense punishable as set forth
               herein.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
